text:
anne: PR #701 touches SDK quickstart, migration examples, and the CLI reference. need a fast style/lint pass before the noon merge window. tagging @ravi @chun for parity + links.

ravi: on it. what are the main risk items?

anne: 1) JS/Go examples don't match the canonical call surface (should be client.text.generate) 2) inconsistent product references (we should use 'Redwood Dedicated' and 'Redwood Private' explicitly) 3) a few internal links break in preview 4) tone flips between directive and promotional language.

chun: i'll normalize calls and make snippets copy-paste ready. plan: switch promise chains to async/await in JS, ensure imports present, and add a one-line auth note. e.g. JS snippet update:
```javascript
// before
client.generate({input: prompt}).then(r => console.log(r))
// after
import { Client } from 'redwood'
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const res = await client.text.generate({ input: prompt })
console.log(res)
```

ravi: i'll grep for product-name variants and replace with canonical names. `rg "Redwood\s+(Dedicated|Private)|\bprivate deploy\b" docs/` gave a couple of hits. will push small changes.

anne: documentation style: use sentence case for headings, prefer active voice for steps, avoid marketing adjectives unless sourced. tiny changes only.

docs-bot: docs preview deployed  https://deploy-preview-701--docs.redwood-inference.dev (status: success)

chun: pushed snippet parity and imports. preview shows updated examples.

ravi: pushed naming normalization and fixed two relative links that pointed outside /docs.

anne: quick review: looks much better. one nit: in the CLI ref please keep flag descriptions consistent (present tense) and remove the phrase "best-in-class".

chun: removed marketing phrase and tightened flag descriptions. ran docs-lint locally; one warning on line length in a code block, harmless.

docs-bot: docs preview updated  https://deploy-preview-701--docs.redwood-inference.dev (status: success)

anne: approving. please add changelog line: "Docs: quickstart & CLI ref — snippet parity, naming cleanup, link fixes" and merge in noon window. also open a tiny lint rule ticket to flag `client.generate(` usage in docs.

ravi: added changelog entry and will merge at noon. thanks team.

chun: merging and will watch CDN flush. closing thread after deploy confirmation. :white_check_mark:
